reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading is partially incorrect. While RPC (codec.rs:696,717) and database (hot_cold_store.rs:2529) paths do bypass verify_data_column_sidecar, they still pass through the KZG verification layer (kzg_utils.rs:validate_data_columns:84-92) which performs the same array length check before calling verify_cell_proof_batch. The defense-in-depth architecture means mismatched arrays will trigger KzgError::InconsistentArrayLength rather than out-of-bounds access. Spec cross-reference confirms invariant is required (fulu-p2p-interface SG-002 INV-004: 'column, kzg_commitments, and kzg_proofs must all have equal length'). The validation exists in two layers: (1) verify_data_column_sidecar for early rejection on gossip/publishing paths, (2) validate_data_columns as final gate before cryptographic operations. Attack scenario of 'out-of-bounds panic or incorrect proof validation' is blocked by the KZG layer check.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu P2P Interface SG-002 INV-004 requires equal array lengths for column, kzg_commitments, and kzg_proofs
